u0: Idle baseline: no client is waiting, no order is active, hands are empty and the siren is silent. Watch for a ring (then go silence the switch) or for a new client arriving (then go take the order); otherwise keep waiting.
u1: The siren is ringing and must be silenced first: walk to the siren switch and toggle it, unless a new client arrives or food slips in the meantime. Do not prepare or serve while in this state.
u10: The client's order is taken, the siren is silent, and cooked food is in hand. Go to the waiting client and toggle to hand over the prepared food. Do not serve if the siren starts ringing; silence it first.
u11: Food has slipped out of the hands. Immediately pick it back up on the very next move: step onto or face the fallen food and pick it up. If the siren is ringing, silence it after recovering the food.
u12: The order is taken and the prepared food is ready but has not yet been handed over. Go to the waiting client and toggle to serve, but if the siren is ringing, go to the switch and silence it first.
u13: A serve just completed (possibly the final hand-over in a sequence) and the shop returns to idle: no waiting client, empty hands. Resume reacting to rings and new clients.
u14: Terminal/final state: the episode's task sequence is complete and the machine stays here, only a siren ring pulling it back to silencing. No further client work is tracked.
u2: A client is waiting at the counter and their order has not been taken yet; the siren is silent. Go face the client and toggle to take the order. If the siren starts ringing, switch priorities to silencing it.
u3: A client is waiting untaken and the siren is also ringing. First go to the switch and toggle it off; the waiting client's order can be taken afterward.
u4: The client's order is taken, hands are empty, and the siren is silent. Go to the pantry, pick up raw food, then head for the stove to prepare it.
u5: The client's order is taken but the siren is ringing and hands are empty. Go toggle the siren switch off before fetching and preparing food.
u6: The client's order is taken, the siren is ringing, and food is already in hand. Go silence the siren at the switch first, keeping the food; preparation and serving come after the siren is off.
u7: The order is taken, hands hold food, and the siren is silent. Go to the stove and toggle to prepare the food; once it is green, head to the client to serve. If the siren starts, silence it before preparing or serving.
u8: An order has just been served successfully; the shop is calm with no waiting client and empty hands. Get ready to silence the next ring or take the next arrival.
u9: A client was served while the siren was ringing, a violation. Clear the siren by going to the switch and toggling it, then resume normal shop work; never serve again until the siren is off.
